title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Neelakanta
desc: A man is obedient towards his mother and overcomes all the obstacles life throws his way. Unfortunately, the matriarch disapproves of his marriage and causes problems for him.

title: Tirupathi
desc: Thirupathi, an honest policeman, sets out to catch Michael, a hardened criminal. However, Michael turns out to be his cheating father, making Thirupathi thirst for revenge.

title: Dashavtara
desc: Angered by Lord Vishnu's act of slaughtering a woman in battle, the venerated sage Bhigu curses the Lord, forcing Him to take countless avatars and atone for His sins.
